slides.sub: Price can lie for an hour. Value can't.

slides.title: Price moves first. Value decides.
slides.body: Price rallies 60 points out of the morning range. The question isn't how far it went, but whether volume followed it there.
slides.tip: Acceptance = time and volume at new prices. Rejection = a fast move and a fast return.

slides.title: POC migration: the clean read
slides.body: Check the developing POC every 30 minutes. In a healthy trend it steps up: 24,410 > 24,445 > 24,480. Each step means business is being done higher.
slides.tip: Value areas that build higher and overlap less = initiative buyers in control.

slides.title: Initiative buying builds new value
slides.body: At the breakout the footprint prints stacked buy imbalances: the ask lifts at 3x or more the bid one tick below, with delta rising.

slides.title: Failed migration: the fade
slides.body: New highs, but the POC is still at 24,410 and the high prints thin volume. Price is out of value without acceptance.

caption:
Is the move ACCEPTED? Read the POC, not the candle 📊

A breakout candle tells you where price went. The developing POC tells you whether the market agreed. When value migrates with price, and the footprint shows initiative buying through stacked imbalances, the new level is being accepted. When price runs but the POC stays behind and the high prints thin volume, the move is out of value without support, and a rotation back to the POC becomes the higher-probability path.

1️⃣ Check the developing POC every 30 minutes
2️⃣ POC stepping up + stacked buy imbalances = acceptance, trade with it
3️⃣ POC stuck behind + thin prints at the high = no acceptance
4️⃣ In a failed migration, target the POC, not the next high
